recipes.label: My Immortal Enemy Bleeds
recipes.startdescription: The world seems to have fallen away, as my enemy and I exhaust ourselves in our fateful duel. Time loses its meaning – hours, years, even centuries seem to have passed. Finally, fatally, my enemy makes a mistake. Just before she destroys me, I put all my strength into a strike that tears her body apart –
recipes.description:
My enemy's flesh chips and shatters like stone, and arterial red spurts relentlessly from that horrific fracture. Yet, my enemy makes no effort to conceal her mortal wound. 'There will always be a day, when the hunter becomes the hunted … Ha. ' Her breath is ragged and weak, but her voice is resolute: 'You have fought valiantly. I cannot deny that. However, your fate will only get worse from here…' 

She soon falls silent. I am unmoved by her final words. I have washed away my shame and cleared my path. My destiny still awaits — it is time to move on.
